title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E04 — Stashes to Ashes
Poised to bootleg their first tariff-free liquor to Canada, Tim and Tickle encounter armed opposition hellbent on torching their plans.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E05 — Dead Drops Don't Lie
When Mark and Huck's shine stash vanishes, the hunt for culprits sparks explosive plans for revenge.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E08 — Washoe County Jail
Inside one of Nevada's busiest jails, deputies battle a non-stop surge of arrests driven by Reno's constant crime and a major trafficking corridor; with gangs entrenched inside, keeping rival groups apart becomes a daily fight for control.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E04 — Caddo Parish Correctional Center
Caddo Parish Correctional Center is struggling with a staffing shortage, the inmates outnumber the deputies by 180 to one; to ensure the safety of both inmates and staff alike, the Emergency Response Team springs into action.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E05 — San Francisco County Jail
In a city gripped by fentanyl and rising drug arrests, San Francisco's largest jail is on the front lines of addiction; it fights to give inmates a shot at recovery, rehabilitation and a path forward.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E06 — Flagler County Jail
At Florida's Flagler County Jail, law and order Sheriff Rick Staly takes a tough approach to corrections while battling the revolving door of repeat offenders through discipline, rehabilitation, and recovery programs.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E08 — San Joaquin County Jail
At the crossroads of one of the West Coast's busiest narcotics corridors, Sheriff Patrick Withrow and his deputies confront violent offenders, rival gangs and the ongoing battle to stop contraband from entering California's San Joaquin County Jail.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E06 — Texas Tornado
When a tornado outbreak strikes Texas and Kansas in 2022, hundreds of eyewitnesses find themselves trapped in the path; as they seek the best shelter they can find, they capture the moments when tornadoes destroy the very structures around them.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E03 — Hellfire in Hawaii
Maui faces the worst natural disaster in 2023, as hurricane-force winds fuel wildfires that catch residents off guard; as eyewitnesses attempt to flee the flames, they film their attempts to escape from the eye of the storm.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E02 — Derecho Superstorm
Hundreds of eyewitnesses film their attempts to escape when a derecho superstorm blasts through Nebraska and Iowa in 2020; then it happens again, only this time, the hurricane-force winds come wrapped in a dust storm.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E04 — Half-Country Hurricane
Showcasing how Hurricane Ida hit the Louisiana coast in 2021 and features films from eyewitnesses as tornadoes and flooding hit all the way to New York City.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E04 — Nebraska Super Outbreak
In April 2024, dozens of tornadoes ravaged NE's Central Plains; eyewitnesses find themselves in the wrong place at the wrong time as twisters tear through neighborhoods, demolish massive commercial structures, and topple semi-trailers.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E06 — Terrifying Twin Twisters
In May 2024, dozens of eyewitnesses capture rare twin tornadoes as they carve a parallel path of destruction across Iowa; with winds near 300 mph, the twister sisters topple farms, shred wind turbines and devastate the town of Greenfield.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S03 E04 — Category 5: Fight to Survive
After hitting Category five, Hurricane Ian slams Florida's Gulf Coast with 150 mph winds and a storm surge that sweeps away homes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E03 — Monster in Michigan
When a rare EF-3 tornado touches down in northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos and disbelief.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S02 E07 — Ultra High Proof
Distillers compete to make a Prohibition-era classic; moonshine up to an ultra-high 180 proof; building their own stills and mash; judging are Mark, Digger, Tim and guest Mark Rogers.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E05 — Quarter Ton of Backwoods Fun
Amanda and Kelly attempt to reinvent an Appalachian apple brandy made famous by a 500-pound woman; Mark and Digger lend Popcorn Sutton's condenser to a new team of shiners; Richard and Jerry find a common cause, putting Mike in the hot seat.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E04 — Rollercoaster Accidents
Drill down on maintenance and safety lapses that derailed amusement park rides.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E05 — Skyscraper Collapses
Pinpoint the mistakes that cause major structural failures; explore the preventable explosion inside London's Ronan Point; the code violations that collapsed Lalita Park; the short circuit that set off a deadly fire in Tehran's Plasco Building.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E06 — Nuclear Plant Disasters
Hunt for the root cause of atomic accidents; examine the Windscale fire, which led to safer reactor designs; learn why swift crisis management helped in the Three Mile Island incident; see why improper waste disposal fuelled the Kyshtym disaster.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery Pistol Packer
Tizzy tries to identify a man filmed pulling a gun on skateboarders; a road rager who reportedly used his coffee cup as a weapon is identified by his tattoos; a confrontation over a car charger leaves a woman seeking Tizzy's help.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S09 E03 — Ransom in the Sky
Josh looks to finally crack the D. B. Cooper case, America's only unsolved skyjacking; a deathbed confession and cutting-edge forensics have Josh hot on the trail of the $200,000 ransom that's never been recovered.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E08 — Cracking the Secret
Josh Gates goes on a nationwide treasure hunt to solve a mystery no one has cracked for 40 years: The Secret; Josh travels coast-to-coast and back in time using cutting-edge augmented reality and tapping into a network of obsessed Secret detectives.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E12 — The Secret Solved
Breaking news about "The Secret" prompts Josh Gates to race across the globe to find out if the series of puzzles has been solved.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E14 — Finding Italy's Lost Empire
Searching a city of the dead, Josh unearths artifacts from the Etruscans who ruled central Italy before being conquered by the Roman Empire; a dig site unearths clues that reveal the Etruscans may have inspired Rome's greatest achievements.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E13 — Donner Party Horror and Heroes
Josh treks the punishing Donner Pass to uncover how desperate pioneers who were trapped by blizzards in the Sierra Nevada turned to cannibalism; in an unprecedented six-month investigation, Josh retraces the steps of the courageous rescue teams.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S09 E06 — America's Titanic
Josh dives the Atlantic in search of millions in lost coins that sunk with America's Titanic.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E04 — Terror Below Deck
Phil and Heather board the USS Hornet, a haunted WWII aircraft carrier said to be crawling with spirits, both good and evil; exploring its decks, they confront eerie signs that the ship's sailors may still be guarding it from beyond the grave.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E09 — The Spanish Boogeyman
Phil and Heather head to Belmonte Castle in La Mancha, Spain, said to be haunted by the Spanish Boogeyman. Inside the castle, they discover surprising secrets that reveal the truth behind the terrifying legend.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E03 — Curse of the Skinwalkers
A series of terrifying encounters in the Navajo Nation has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. With the help of a local expert, Phil and Heather journey deep into a cursed valley and investigate a cave that few dare to enter.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E04 — Ghosts of Guam
Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores. After reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E06 — The Bumper Sticker Brawl
Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker. A judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast food worker, and a couple of road rage incidents have Tizzy fired up.

Captain Joe Dion takes his sons to sea, landing two massive bluefin and witnessing a great white shark feeding on a humpback whale; Dylan's son Emmett earns his first harpoon attempt while Niko hunts the season's biggest bluefin thus far.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E06 — Tennessee Spirit
When Amanda tracks down a lost apple variety made famous by outlaw brandy, she and Kelly distill a liquor so extraordinary that Mark and Digger find themselves a little too deep in the bottle; Tim and Howard invent a novel double-distilling device.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E03 — Vacation Mayhem
Vacations create new experiences and memories that last a lifetime; every misadventure, from spring break smackdowns to terrible tourist fails.

title: Caught!
description:
Man vs. Machine
Unveiling the uproarious clash between humans and machines; from power tools to semi-trucks, each moment is a lighthearted adventure in the whimsical battle of man vs. machine.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E15 — Roadway Ridiculousness
Motorists and pedestrians, beware -- whether it's teens stealing police cruisers or taxi drivers fighting off assailants with insane driving maneuvers, the highway is a danger zone until law enforcement takes down the menacing drivers.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E13 — Grand Theft Viral
When jewel thieves get stuck in a shop, a fleeing carjacker hides in a port-a-potty, and a criminal tries to escape in a 20-ton construction vehicle, the law fights back and puts them behind bars.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E15 — Nude, Crude, and Unscrewed
Being naked in public is about as bold a choice as one can make, but there's something special about these free and fearless frolickers. Raunchy rule-breakers demonstrate how breaking societal norms and laws can put one in a pickle.

title: Caught!
description:
The Friendly Skies
A compilation of hilarious clips from around the world featuring airborne comedy, including in-flight antics and unexpected encounters in the air.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E12 — Holidays From Hell
Holidays highlight unique traditions, but when clashing personalities and lots of alcohol get mixed, mayhem and memorable stories are sure to follow.

title: Caught!
description:

They say blood is thicker than water, but family can put one through the wringer; sibling squabbles, petty pranks and daring parental rescues.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S02 E07 — Crying Uncle
A drunk driver causes a three-car crash; a man attempts to import counterfeit goods; an investigation is launched into a pill-smuggling ring, and a shipment of cocaine is found inside office furniture; an armed robber on the run is captured.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S02 E05 — Yes, Deer?
Methamphetamine is found hidden within a semi-truck full of frozen broccoli, a man is caught smuggling pills inside containers of protein powder, a traveler tries to bring a deer trophy across the border, and an intoxicated US citizen is detained.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S01 E03 — Fueled by Meth
In their battle against the cartels, Customs and Border Protection flag a tractor-trailer transporting tanks of liquid methamphetamine; officers nab an exotic reptile smuggler; 36 pounds of cocaine are found inside a pickup truck.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E10 — Super-load Sunday
Officers are caught off guard when a high-end sports car arrives at the border packing heat. At the bus terminal, a K9 alerts to a traveler's luggage. Upon investigation, officers find photographs showing large amounts of cash on her phone.

description:
S01 E04 — Swimming in Orbeez
Mark helps viewers dive into three pools; one is filled with 25 million Orbeez, one is filled with liquid sand and one is filled with jello; he unveils a never-before-seen, top-secret blaster.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E07 — Legalize It!
Accident-prone Josh attempts a solo fix to his still site, while Tickle heads to the West Virginia State House to launch his legalization campaign; Arkansas double cousins Big Chuk and Joe Boy risk bootlegging their shine by boat to Louisiana.

title: Dual Survival
description:
S03 E07 — Twin Peaks
Tempers flare over different survival tactics as Joe and Cody struggle to escape the Nicaraguan jungle.

title: Dual Survival
description:
S03 E02 — Mars on Earth
Joe and Cody battle dehydration and hypothermia in Chile's Atacama Desert, an area known as "Mars on Earth."

title: Dual Survival
description:
S03 E05 — Trouble in Paradise
Joe and Cody lock heads over priorities while trying to survive the jungle of an uninhabited Hawaiian island.

title: Dual Survival
description:
S03 E08 — Meltdown
Joe and Cody struggle to avoid territorial hippos and herds of elephants while stranded in the middle of Zambia's wild plains.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E01 — Alaska Winter-vention
The Raneys intervene to save an Alaskan family exiled to tents by a mold-infested cabin; facing bears, an arsenic-laced spring, and staring down a seven-month winter, they have one shot to make the homestead livable.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E05 — Harsh Reality
A worried sister calls the Raneys to save an Arizona family chasing social media clout instead of survival; they gamble on a disease-ridden, abandoned building that could either secure food and shelter or sink the entire rescue.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E04 — Bee Stings and Better Days
In NM, parents fear for a son battling Lyme; the Raneys discover he's turned to bee sting therapy, a plan that unravels when his homestead's hive vanishes; they face a brutal choice as stress worsens his condition: push on or risk permanent damage.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E13 — Those in Peril on the Sea
Captains Sig and Sophia shift their fishing strategy as back-to-back injuries plague the Northwestern deck crew.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E14 — Curse of the Hybrids
Captains Sig and Sophia locate hybrid crab, hitting the jackpot, but filling their tanks creates an imbalance, putting the Northwestern on the brink of capsize.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E15 — Aleutian Solution
Sig's crew races to jettison pots and repair a flooding compartment below deck. Rick radios Johnathan to help hide his honey hole, but when Jake spots the Time Bandit's unusual movements, he calls Rick's bluff.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E16 — Contagion
As Jake sets gear in heavy seas, a painful skin infection spreads among the Cornelia Marie crew.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E17 — Raw Nerves
On the Time Bandit, Johnathan delegates dentistry duties when his brother Neal's dental implants fail far out to sea. Battling 25-foot waves, Keith leans heavily on his co-captain Monte.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E04 — Tornado Alley Weed Farm
Six teams of chasers brave Oklahoma back roads as a late spring warm front unleashes long-track tornadoes.
